Validasi rantai

The process of verifying each certificate in a chain from the end entity up to the root CA, ensuring all links are trusted and unbroken in PKI trust models.

Definition

The process of verifying each certificate in a chain from the end entity up to the root CA, ensuring all links are trusted and unbroken in PKI trust models.

Operational example

Chain validation ensures that every certificate, including intermediates, is trusted up to the root authority.

Localized term

Validasi rantai

Localized example
